rationale: Calculated corrected wind speeds using air density adjustment, applied power curve formula to get power for each scenario (8 turbines × 2.5 MW = 20 MW rated), then computed p10/p50/p90 quantiles using linear interpolation with pos=q*(n-1). All scenarios were in the cubic region (between cut-in and rated) except t02-s5 which hit rated power (20 MW).
